status: PRE-REGISTERED before source-isolation or group QA measurements
basis: ASSUMED photographic classification, not a published lighting standard; strict majority defines dominance. Client: shade over sun.

source_probe.mask: same pixel indices for every source; lowest 97% of summed lamps-only plus daylight-only luminance, positive combined values only
source_probe.statistic: sum of linear luminance over fixed mask; lamps/(lamps+daylight); solar=max(0,daylight-sky_only)/daylight, clamped to [0,1]

assignment_order: Preserve evening and exterior-dusk exposure presets, including day-state gallery already using evening
For original day or exterior-day: lamps fraction > 0.5 -> lamp-dominant
Otherwise original exterior-day and solar fraction <= 0.5 -> exterior-shade
Otherwise keep original day or exterior-day
exterior_shade_definition: Exterior daytime subjects represented by the camera meter are predominantly sky-lit, with at most half their daylight luminance attributable to the sun disc. Same scene and camera with only Nishita sun_disc disabled measures sky-only; includes indirect sunlight. No identifiers, compass names or QA outcomes select membership.

white_balance.lamp-dominant: nearest integer kelvin, emitted-flux-weighted CCT of authored active analytic lamps across all member views, weighted once per lamp per view at its authored driver/view dimmer; include emissive-only sources by measured area*exitance and exclude analytic companion lenses to avoid double counting

exposure: Unchanged photoreal.camera_meter per view: 24 samples, 15% image scale, top 3% removed, logarithmic average, -0.4 stop bias, unchanged capped highlight priority; upper median across complete group, independent of selected render subset
cohort: All authored views, including retired diagnostic members, retain metering participation for compatibility; every active view is assigned automatically. Preserve evening/dusk cohort order and settings.
freeze: Save probe values, derived assignments, view inputs and complete transport fingerprint by value. Validate assignment by recomputation, immutable canonical rule equality, measurement digest and live transport/view hashes; any change requires new pre-registered measurement, never a hand membership override.
qa: Production render_qa unchanged, every selected view, no exemptions
